description: This file defines interfaces for IPC channels within the Rialto project, including factory creation and channel management, with classes IChannelFactory and IChannel, and their associated methods.

classes.name: IChannelFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IPC channels, providing methods to create channels from socket paths or file descriptors.

classes.name: IChannel
classes.description: Interface for an IPC channel, providing methods for connection management, event processing, and subscription.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Static method to create a shared pointer to an IChannelFactory instance.

methods.name: createChannel
methods.description: Creates a connected IChannel object from a socket path.

methods.name: createChannel
methods.description: Creates a connected IChannel object from a socket file descriptor.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the IPC channel from the socket.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the IPC channel is currently connected.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns the epoll file descriptor associated with the channel.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for I/O events on the channel, with optional timeout.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a single event on the channel.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to an event message of a specific protobuf message type.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from an event message using its event tag.
